# GetCameraClipPlaneEnabled

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Cameras](Blitz3D-Cameras)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetCameraClipPlaneEnabled:Int32 camera:Int32, index:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `camera` | In | Int32 | required | Camera handle. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Which plane, from 0 to 5. |

**Returns:** 1 if the plane cuts, 0 if it is off.

## Description

Tells whether one of the 6 clip planes of a camera is on, as set with [SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled](SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraClipPlaneEnabled camera, 3, True
Print GetCameraClipPlaneEnabled(camera, 3)
WaitKey
```
